messages:
Marta (growth): ok team — I pushed the new LaunchBoard dashboard to staging, can folks eyeball the webinar vs inbound tabs? :eyes:
Ryan H: on it, quick glance looks solid. love the new cohort toggles.
Nelson S: saw a spike in attributed inbound on 4/11 that doesn't match GA events, maybe sample rate mismatch? @Marta (growth)
Marta (growth): noted. dashboard uses attribution_window=7d and our GA pull is 14d for the demo. could explain it.
Yasmin L: also saw some weird UTM mapping — fb_campaign sometimes lands as (not set). Might be our landing template.
Ryan H: quick check: sample_rate flag was 0.1 for one of the connectors last week. I switched it back yesterday.
Nelson S: ah that would do it. can we add a banner on the dashboard when sample_rate != 1.0? so it's obvious to viewers
Marta (growth): good idea — dashbot can we show a warning row when sample_rate < 1?
dashbot: automated note: added a "sampling" badge to staging LaunchBoard when sample_rate != 1.0. See /dash-config/logs/launchboard.
Ryan H: fyi the webinar tab conversion rates look lower than expected vs last quarter — but our contact import had a 0.5% dedupe bug that inflated prior numbers.
Yasmin L: can we surface raw counts and deduped counts side-by-side? marketing ops needs to be able to justify the shift in the deck.
Marta (growth): yes, add columns: raw_leads, deduped_leads, source_match_rate. put them in the weekly export.
Nelson S: also propose a quick note on attribution assumptions near the top: attribution_window, last_touch vs multi-touch, sample_rate, and contact-import version. saves repeated Slack threads.
Ryan H: squad sprint note: I'll add the banner and raw/deduped columns — ETA end of day.
Marta (growth): perfect. Yasmin and Nelson can you validate against the webinar CSV exports after Ryan deploys?
Yasmin L: yup, will run the CSV check and report mismatches.
Nelson S: will cross-check GA events and share a short list of anomalies.
Marta (growth): thanks. one action item for the weekly KPI review: update the metric card narrative to call out the dedupe change and sampling. I'll add to the deck.
Ryan H: putting a short SQL we used to sanity check counts in case anyone wants to run ad-hoc:
```
select date(created_at), count(*) as raw, count(distinct email) as deduped
from leads
where created_at >= '2025-04-01'
group by 1
order by 1 desc
```
Yasmin L: nice. that will help comms.
Marta (growth): ok closing this thread for now — Ryan to push, Nelson/Yasmin to validate, I'll update the KPI slide. ping here when done. :thumbsup:
Ryan H: pushed to prod — banner visible, new columns in export.
Yasmin L: validated webinar CSV vs dashboard for 4/10-4/14 — found 12 mismatches, mostly trailing whitespace in utm_campaign. filing a doc in /marketing/ops/utm-cleanup.md
Nelson S: GA crosswalk done — 3 event names were inconsistent between staging and production. fixed mapping + deployment.
Marta (growth): great work. we'll call this out in Friday's KPI sync with a 1-slide note. thanks all! :chart_with_upwards_trend:
